summary: Verified z-index fix for Zampa POS modal 'Historial de Días' and 'Vueltos'. Both modals open, their close buttons are visible, on top of the floating dock (elementFromPoint returns the button itself), clickable, and successfully close the modal (display:none). Fix confirmed: .modal-overlay z-index=10000 > .dock-inferior z-index=9999.
critical_code_review_comments: Buttons (btn-cerrar-modal-historial, btn-cancelar-vueltos) geometrically overlap the dock bounding box at bottom of viewport, but due to higher z-index they win at hit-testing. This works but on some devices with different safe-areas the dock might feel visually distracting behind the close button — consider hiding .dock-inferior while a modal-overlay is open for cleaner UX.
test_credentials: PIN Admin 1234 / localStorage.zampa_rol=admin (client-side only, no server auth)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844 used. To reproduce: set localStorage zampa_animado=true and zampa_rol=admin, reload, then call window.mostrarHistorialCierres() or click balance-card. Verified elementFromPoint at btn center = the button itself for both modals. Close actions set display:none as expected.
rca of the issue: Root cause: .modal-overlay had z-index 1000 while .dock-inferior floating dock uses 9999, so dock sat above the modal and intercepted taps on the Cerrar button positioned near viewport bottom. Fix: raise .modal-overlay z-index to 10000 (style.css line ~1188). Toast-container remains at 99999 so notifications still layer on top. Verified via elementFromPoint hit-test that button is topmost element.
